packet.comment: Plays a personal scene for this player, now. The payload is the scene as compact JSON in ASCII: its id, kind, map, time of day, cast (with every actor's ENF id), compiled cues and the audio it uses (see RUNTIME.md). The client plays it and answers with Scene_Accept for each choice, Scene_Use for each map cue, and Scene_Close when it ends.
Stops the scene this player is watching, if any: they were warped, killed or kicked. The client puts the map back as it is.

Another player in range has stepped into an instanced scene: they are out of the world until Scene_Agree. The client stops drawing them. (A classic client, which doesn't know this family, gets Avatar_Remove instead.)
A player in range is back from an instanced scene, where it left them: draw them again. The same body as Players_Agree. (A classic client gets Players_Agree.)
